text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"That was close, wasn't it?
Just a little bit more, and yet—"
choice_data_list: Sorry, I wasn't able to get it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Please don't pay it any mind.
I couldn't win a Paka Petit plushie—
but I had a wonderful time nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes, cheering them on is... very.
Just watching makes my heart pound so fast.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Usually, I am the one being cheered on, but
being on the cheering side is wonderful as well, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"This is entirely because you gave it your all,
Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"So I am truly, completely satisfied.
Thank you... very much—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
